sourceAnchors.quote: {{annotate|任氏曰：通关者，引通克制之神也。所谓阴阳二用，妙在气交，天降而下，地升而上。天干之气动而专，地支之气静而杂，是故地运有推移，而天气从之；天气有转徒，而地运应之；天气动于上，而人元应之；人元动于下，而天气从之，所以阴胜逢阳则止，阳胜逢阴则往，是谓天地交泰，干支有情，左右不背，阴阳生育而相通也，若杀重喜印，杀露印亦露，煞藏印亦，此显然通达，不必节外生枝。倘原局无印，必须岁运逢印，向而通之，或暗会明合而通之，局内有印，被财星损坏，或官星化之，或比劫解之，或被合住，则冲开之，或被冲坏，则合化之，或隔一物，则克去-之，前后上下，不能授引，得岁运相逢尤佳。如年印时杀，干杀支印，前后远立，上下悬隔，或为间神忌物所间，此原局无可通之理，必须岁运暗冲暗会，克制间神忌物，该冲则冲，该合则合，引通相克之势，此关一通，所谓琴遇子期，马逢伯乐，求名者青钱万选，问利者意则屡中，如牛郎织女之入洞房，无不其所愿。杀印之论如此，食伤财官之论亦如此。}}

assumptions: 绝不冒称任注真假从全部条件

rules.title: 固定载体控制预算收缩结算
assumptions: 系数、路径、容量与rootFactor在内迭代保持不变。
列和<=.25的L1收缩及向外浮点误差界被逐盘核验。
超限/非法/不有限不回退旧控制算法。

rules.title: 同一财、同一印、同一日主的单边干预净效
assumptions: 原文只支持对象和顺序，数值充分条件属于项目提案。
指定W→R伤害、R全部受制量、R→D贡献三项分别超误差界改善。
关闭指定B→W边不删除载体、不重分配其它控制系数。
多项干预收益不相加；不认证官杀来源穿透。

rules.title: 有限容量机制枚举与后验根一致性
assumptions: 最多四个不同明干工作五行，共不超过16态；同根谓词合并。
各态从固定snapshot重建累计量和本态C/A，内核冻结。
根事实不随受损删除；有效性为单载体区间门槛意见。
唯一、多解、无解、区间待定都是正常结果；不选最强/最后态。

limitations: 分日司权、半合拱会、刑穿害、六合化气、墓库开闭、暗合、根反馈对关系资格反向更新、完整杀印源流及多轮救应与真假从例外未覆盖。
没有经验校准；完整结论仅为本项目规则内文化取法候选。
各数值是项目规则权重，不是命局能量实测值；假设的可执行不等于完整传统目标已解决。
默认月支入口的身旺从儿正例仍未证明；显式月干样本不替代该覆盖。
1.3外层穷举不认证全局唯一存在；合化资格不受根反馈重定，完整杀印来源穿透仍未闭合。

twoAxisPolicy.bodyStrength: Original final-pool support share and original0.60/0.40 cutoffs, unchanged.

twoAxisPolicy.collectiveWealth: Only explicitly traced output-to-wealth receiving carriers form this aggregate; not a general assertion that any micro-carriers can substitute a primary.

entryPolicy.note: Default retains the old principal-month-branch entry; extra month-stem entry is explicit, separate and under review.

fixedControlBudget.coefficients: 0.25*C_i*path(j,i)/sum_k(C_k*path(j,k)); represented conservatively downward with upward denominator
fixedControlBudget.intervention: Only specified B→W coefficient disabled; all other frozen coefficients and capacities retained; no budget redistribution
fixedControlBudget.boundaryPolicy: Outward intervals and roundoff bounds; uncertain numerical prerequisites leave explicit alternatives
fixedControlBudget.numericCertificate: Exact binary frozen column sums <=.25; outward operator/iteration roundoff bound; downstream nonnegative intervals; zero-denominator uncertainty never divided.

rootTerms.capacityRoot: Each enumerated rooted/fallback assumption fixes this regime capacity before the inner solve
rootTerms.posteriorRoot: Final hidden power intervals determine consistency of the regime; never update inside the inner solve

rootFeedback.outerMethod: Complete finite enumeration, not a fixed-point uniqueness theorem
rootFeedback.fallback: Frozen original working-element seed resource plus existing epsilon >=1 uses .7, otherwise .35
rootFeedback.rootPredicate: At least one eligible hidden final-power interval plus epsilon >=.5; no micro-root summation
rootFeedback.unknown: Incomplete input, unadopted transformation qualification or threshold overlap is unknown
rootFeedback.relations: Frozen adopted relations/working elements; no root-to-transformation feedback
rootFeedback.intervention: Same-regime conditional net effect differs from full re-enumeration feedback; only two unique complete resolutions can prove definite restoration
rootFeedback.nativeFacts: Original hidden order supplied by frozen original hidden-stem table; never inferred from ID sorting
rootFeedback.hypotheses: Explicit hour hypotheses retain hypothetical=true in chart, every consumed regime, input trace and pure DTO; original missing-hour baseline remains pending
rootFeedback.conditionalNetCertificate: Single disabled rescue edge, same attacking carrier and hidden root; fixed-regime damage/net root loss/final root-power improvement beyond interval error. Full re-enumeration restoration additionally requires both sides unique and actual threshold crossing.

opinionAggregationRevision.scope: Root resolution and downstream opinion resolution are distinct.
opinionAggregationRevision.allOpinionCertificate: All retained consumers exist, resolved and numerical prerequisites clear; no relevant missing or conditional alternatives.
opinionAggregationRevision.pending: Per-regime exact missing and conditional state projected to top-level pending; alternatives retained without a default primary.
